title: The AutoDiag REST API
keywords: autodiag rest api http endpoint endpoints openapi integrate integration script automation healthz json call script scripts program programmatically
text: Everything the dashboard and the RViz panel do goes through a REST API, documented with OpenAPI at /api/docs. Useful endpoints: GET /api/healthz (liveness), /api/version, /api/topics, /api/topic-inspect?topic=/scan, /api/graph, POST /api/compare and /api/report, and the assistant stream at /api/assistant/stream. The API is read-only, listens on 127.0.0.1 by default and needs a token when exposed on the network.
